newsitem.title: USA: Torrey Pines plans to acquire two firms.
newsitem.headline: Torrey Pines plans to acquire two firms.

text.p: Torrey Pines Nevada Inc, an American company based in Raratonga, Cook Islands, said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire United Casinos Corp and Net Bet Inc.
In a statement, Torrey Pines, an Internet gaming concern, said that "an agreement between the three companies should be reached by no later than July 31, 1997."
Torrey Pines said the proposed combination of the three companies will create a company with about $2.3 million in assets and less than $100,000 in liabilities.
According to a published report, an Irvine, Calif.-based company, owns a 43 percent stake in Net Bet, which plans to offer casino-type games on the Internet.
